h1: Fellowship Scheduling Software? We Can Build the Schedule For You
paragraph: As a managed service, Scheduling Wizard takes your rules and delivers a finished schedule built to the ACGME requirements, as Excel or Google Sheets, or on a custom live view we build for you.

cta.title: Get Your Fellowship Schedule Done Right
cta.description: Book a call to talk through your scheduling needs and learn how Scheduling Wizard works. Join 30+ departments across 20+ hospitals and practices that have us build their call, block, clinic and shift schedules.

faq.answer: Fellowship scheduling software refers to tools or services used to build ACGME-compliant rotation, call, and clinic schedules for fellowship training programs. Most solutions are self-service platforms that require chief fellows to learn and operate the software themselves. Scheduling Wizard differs by operating as a managed service, programs submit their rules and receive finished schedules, built to your rules, as Excel or Google Sheets, or on a custom live view we build for you, with no software to learn or operate.
faq.question: What is fellowship scheduling software and how does Scheduling Wizard differ?

faq.answer: Yes. Our team applies the ACGME duty hour requirements while the schedule is built, before it reaches your program. The subspecialty requirements you tell us apply go in too; it is the most common question fellowship programs ask, so we ask it back. The review afterwards is a check, not a repair job.
faq.question: Is Scheduling Wizard compliant with ACGME fellowship duty hour requirements?

faq.answer: The subspecialty requirements you tell us apply go straight into the build. Rather than applying a one-size-fits-all compliance check, you tell us the duty hour and rotation requirements that apply to your subspecialty and we apply them as the schedule is built. This is one of the most critical capabilities for fellowship programs, where rules can differ significantly from categorical residency requirements.
faq.question: How does Scheduling Wizard handle subspecialty-specific ACGME fellowship rules?

faq.answer: Scheduling Wizard generates Block rotation schedules, Call schedules with fairness optimization, Clinic schedules, and Attending schedules. All four schedule types are built together, so that changes in one schedule type are automatically resolved across the others. Finished schedules are delivered as Excel or Google Sheets, or on a custom live view we build for you that programs can upload to their existing publishing platform.
faq.question: What types of fellowship schedules does Scheduling Wizard generate?

faq.answer: With traditional fellowship scheduling software or manual Excel processes, institutional scheduling knowledge is lost when a chief fellow rotates out. Scheduling Wizard keeps your program's rules and requests written down from year to year. New chief fellows inherit the written rule set and last year's schedule.
faq.question: What happens to our fellowship scheduling setup when a new chief fellow takes over?

faq.answer: Yes, and many Scheduling Wizard clients use exactly this setup. Scheduling Wizard handles the schedule building, producing finished schedules as Excel or Google Sheets, or on a custom live view we build for you. Programs then upload those files to your existing platform for day-to-day schedule viewing and access. Scheduling Wizard is designed to complement existing publishing platforms rather than replace them, so there is no disruption to how your fellows and attendings check their schedules.
faq.question: Can Scheduling Wizard work alongside your existing platform for our fellowship program?
